  <strong>2026-05-25</strong> – <a href="https://github.com/insin/git-guis">git-guis</a> <a href="https://github.com/insin/git-guis/releases/tag/v0.0.1">v0.0.1</a>
  <div><em>git-gui with tabs</em></div>
  <details><summary>v0.0.1 release notes</summary><p>Initial test release</p>
<p>git-gui is my favourite interface for separately reviewing code from the place it's written, crafting commits with selected lines.</p>
<p>But git-gui requires a separate window per repo, and the macOS dock has issues with wish.</p>
<p>Git Guis is just the bits I use from git-gui (and a little bit of gitk) in a tabbed interface.</p>
<p>Notable differences:</p>
<ul>
<li>Cmd/Ctrl + T also supports staging/unstaging selected lines</li>
</ul></details>
